spot_checks.REV-5 (AC1 link DOM attribute): DEEP-VERIFIED. Read MarkdownView.tsx:365-378 directly. RenderSpanItem renders `<Text accessibilityRole={isExternalLink ? 'link' : undefined} {...webProps} onPress={...}>` where webProps adds `onClick={handleWebClick}` only on web for external links. There is NO `href` prop being set. AC1 (line 302) correctly asserts `role="link"` + onClick + text content equality, and explicitly states 'this is NOT an HTML <a> element with an href attribute'. The fix would no longer fail-on-truth.
